notes: imd/acc on Ethereum mainnet: one contract, the Stacker, against the live IMD token and the live StakedIMD (sIMD) vault. Live since launch #1409 at 0x06909f672301f28a810f78cfe7a754851269f4f0; this is its code. No owner, admin, fee, pause or upgrade. credit(trader, imdAmount) refuses a zero trader (ZeroTrader) and the Stacker, the vault or the IMD token as trader (InvalidTrader), pulls IMD from the calling project and calls sIMD.deposit(imdAmount, trader), so the shares go straight to the trader, then emits Stacked(project, trader, imd, shares). The constructor only stores the two addresses and makes no external call, so the empty-chain rehearsal passes; the first non-zero credit checks sIMD.asset() == IMD and approves the vault once, and a failed credit rolls both back. TestIMD and TestSIMD under test/mocks are test doubles and are not deployed.
